描述_EN: finely carved head of a buddha with traces of pigments. the face is smoothly carved with a meditative expression, the eyes cast down beneath arched eyebrows. south asian features of the deity, such as the swirled strands of hair, the high-ridged nose and heavy eyelids still appear, yet the gently rounded face points to tang-chinese interests in the human form. the head bears stylistic features from a transitional period of chinese buddhist art at longmen. the hair is carved with triple-spiralled curls. over the course of the period, artisans created buddhist deities with increasing awareness of movements and soft flesh of the human body. a straight nose above curving lips and long, pendulous ears.
描述_ZN: 精雕细琢的菩萨头像，有颜料的痕迹。 面部雕刻流畅，表情沉思，眼睛在弧形的眉毛下投下。 神像的南亚特征，如旋转的发丝、高耸的鼻子和厚重的眼睑仍然出现，但柔和的圆脸表明了唐代人对人形的兴趣。 头部有龙门的中国佛教艺术过渡时期的风格特征。 头发上雕刻着三螺旋的卷发。 在这一时期，工匠们在创作佛教神像时对人体的动作和柔软的肉体有了越来越多的认识。 直的鼻子在弯曲的嘴唇上方，长而下垂的耳朵。
